item.title: A17 closed in multi vehicle collision
item.description: The eastbound lane of the A17 at Ruskington has been closed following a multi vehicle collision. No serious injuries are reported. Please avoid the area while investigations take place and the vehicles are recovered. Incident 104 of 5 January 26 refers.
